subject_rule: Not limited to a subject list: the RGC says candidates seeking admission as new full-time PhD students at the eight participating universities are eligible, and that shortlisted applications are reviewed, according to their area of study, by one of two selection panels (Sciences, Medicine, Engineering and Technology; or Humanities, Social Sciences and Business Studies). The fellowship is held in a PhD programme that one of the eight universities offers, so the programmes below are the fields.

notes: Recorded 310 PhD fields/programmes/units in total for the doctorate level, from seven of the eight universities: HKU 82 (faculties' academic units and disciplines marked as admitting research postgraduates, plus 4 interdisciplinary schools), CUHK 70 (PhD or MPhil-PhD programmes only; MPhil-only, taught and the Master of Fine Arts and Doctor of Music entries left out), PolyU 32 (departments, with their research areas in the detail field), HKBU 27 (including the ITS Transdisciplinary PhD), Lingnan 22 (16 MPhil/PhD plus 6 collaborative double PhD programmes), EdUHK 31 (14 academic departments plus 17 featured research areas), HKUST 46 (programmes and concentrations).

The RGC states no total. The City University of Hong Kong list could not be read (see fetch_problems), so the list is NOT complete for CityU; the RGC page says it has a Fields of PhD Studies page for the HKPFS.

The HKU list shows units that admit research postgraduates (marked with a hash on the page); two Arts centres marked as not accepting applications for 2027/28 are left out. Some schools (Biomedical Engineering, Computing and Data Science, Future Media, Innovation) are shared by several HKU faculties and are listed once. Cross-appointed units: HKU Faculty of Business and Economics takes PhD applications only; the Faculty of Education takes the Main Round and 1st Clearing Round only.
EdUHK: the page calls its research areas 'featured' and points to a research repository for others, so the EdUHK list is the departments plus the featured areas, not a closed list.
Programme lists reflect the university pages as read on 2026-11-14 (2027/28 intake where the page says so); universities can change them.
any_subject is not set: no official page says in so many words that every subject is open, although none limits the field to a list; each university's programme list applies.
not_stated: A single list of HKPFS fields kept by the RGC (it refers to each university's own list)
Number of fellowships per panel or per field
CityU programme list as read from its own page
fetch_problems: City University of Hong Kong pages (its HKPFS page and research degree programmes page) answer automated requests with a bot-protection block, so no CityU field list could be read; not bypassed.
The HKUST page is also behind a protection check for direct downloads; its programme list was read through the page-fetch tool and the headings and names are as that tool returned them.
No further university pages (per-department pages) were opened beyond the lists named above.
